label: fig:comparators
action: rework of the inline tikzpicture at thesis_v2/Sections/04b-representation.tex:80-184

width_measured.note: 1cm of tikz coordinate = 1cm on the page. Nothing is resized.

what_changed: Row B: seven marks, one labelled; now every mark is named by its layer. The three at 3.6/3.8/4.2 (layers 16, 12, 9) are 1.1mm and 2.2mm apart and are braced and named as an ordered set rather than given three converging leaders.
Row A: 'slab projected out' now carries a leader back to its 0.121 mark, which it previously stood 0.4cm to the right of, nearer the shuffled-label rule than its own point.

Row C: 'single-cell arm' marker changed from a hollow ring to a solid fill; the dotted zero rule is interrupted across the marker's height (nearest approach now 4.8pt centre-to-rule-end, 3.4pt edge-to-rule-end); label starts 0.30cm clear of the marker edge with a leader through the interruption.
Rows C and D: label gap after an interval bar raised from 0.13cm to 0.30cm, so 'optimal-transport barycentric' and 'single cell' no longer read as continuations of their bars.
Row spacing opened (dividers -0.70 / -2.76 / -5.82; axes 0 / -2.05 / -5.05 / -7.40) to pay for the added labels. Figure is 13mm taller than v1.
No mark moved, no scale changed, no value changed, caption unchanged.

rows.question: Is it there?
rows.quantity: twelve-way drug decode accuracy from the residual stream

marks.label: slab projected out
marks.source: RESULTS_cluster/workspace_probe.json :: layers.*.drug_decode_ablated (constant across all seven layers)
marks.thesis: "Accuracy falls from $0.41$--$0.82$ to a constant $0.121$ floor"

marks.label: raw probe, peak
marks.thesis: tab:workspace layer 9 raw = 0.821; prose "reads $82\%$ at layer 9"

marks.label: context removed
marks.thesis: tab:workspace layer 16 context-removed = 0.883; prose "to $0.883$ ($88\%$) at the deepest layer"

rows.question: Is it used?
rows.quantity: mean KL cost of ablating the purified drug slab, divided by the matched-dimension random null at the same layer

comparator.label: matched-dimension random subspace
comparator.note: the null is the unit of this axis by construction

rows.thesis: tab:workspace Ratio column, all seven rows, identical to one decimal; prose "costs $3.6$--$18.6\times$ the matched-dimension random null"
rows.layer_to_ratio_check: the seven ratios are drawn in value order, not layer order; the layer labels restore the mapping the v1 figure omitted

rows.question: Is it which drug?
rows.quantity: swap-minus-permuted effect as a fraction of that model's own clean preference gap, alpha = 0.5 rung, layer 12

comparators.label: pre-registered margin
comparators.thesis: "a $10\%$ margin pre-registered for calling an effect material"; the margin is stored per arm in absolute nats (seed 43: 0.007536, seed 45: 0.008158) and is 10% of that arm's clean gap by construction

marks.label: residual arm, anchor seed
marks.thesis: tab:identity row 1 and \ci{+0.0197}{+0.0063}{+0.0335} in the prose

marks.label: single-cell arm, median over its depths
marks.source: RESULTS_cluster/probe_arm_single_cell.json :: median over layers.*.swap.diff_perm_norm, six depths (layer 12 absent, cell-line headroom 3.88x < the 5x gate)
marks.thesis: tab:identity last row "nothing detectable at any depth (median $-0.0012$)"
marks.no_interval_by_design: drawn as a bare marker; the per-depth median is not an estimator the pipeline returns an interval for

rows.question: Does a better target help?
rows.quantity: model NIR minus its random-partner scramble's NIR, identifiable stratum, n = 204 conditions, clustered over 40 cell lines

verification.result: no disagreement. Every value drawn was recomputed from RESULTS_cluster and matches the thesis text at the precision the thesis prints.
verification.provenance_note_not_a_disagreement: Row D's single-cell row comes from stratify_sameplate_final.json (model 0.7677, control-copy 0.7655, stratum reference 0.9382 -- the 0.768 / 0.766 / 0.938 the section quotes). A second single-cell run exists, stratify_singlecell_t1t2.json, whose scramble gap is +0.0114 [-0.0182, +0.0408] and whose model NIR is 0.7707. The thesis consistently uses the first in both v1 and v2, so the figure does too; the second is a different run, not a competing value for the same row.
verification.banned_term_check: the string 'noise ceiling' does not appear in the figure. The row C and row D comparators are named 'pre-registered margin' and zero; the stratum reference is not drawn.

integration.how: in thesis_v2/Sections/04b-representation.tex replace the inline tikzpicture (lines 80-184) with \input{figs/comparators}; the surrounding figure/fullwidth float, \caption and \label stay as they are.
integration.tested_by: thesis_v2/figs/_harness_comparators.tex -- a minimal document that \input{preamble} and builds the figure inside \begin{figure}\begin{fullwidth}, with the real caption. Builds clean under pdflatex; only undefined-\cref warnings, which are expected in a harness that has no tables.
